_what: Is the draft SHAPED like you. The other half of the voice question: a voice checker asks whether it SOUNDS like you and never asks what shape the thing is.
_why: Found the hard way. One post ran twelve drafts and four rejections of the opening line before anyone measured that the author's own median opener is 9 words and every draft opened with 20 to 30. Nothing could see it, so nobody could say it.
_how: Point `corpus_glob` at your own published posts. The bands are DERIVED from them at run time, never shipped as numbers: a hardcoded median is a second source of truth that goes stale the day you write another post.
_hook_definition: Words in the first sentence OR the first line, whichever ends first. A line break ends the hook even mid-sentence, because that is what a reader sees before deciding to keep going.

_platform_overrides._what: Where a platform's mechanics should beat your own habit. Empty by default: your corpus wins unless you deliberately say otherwise.
_platform_overrides._example: A platform that pays for reading time rather than for likes rewards a post long enough to be worth expanding, even if your own habit is shorter. That is a decision to record here, per channel, with the reason.
